title: FY27 Sidewalk Repair and Replacement
size: Citywide sidewalk/ADA repair package along Westside Parkway, Kimball Bridge Road and Clubhouse Drive
timing: Bids are due September 17, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET. Scope includes demolition/disposal of existing concrete sidewalk, new sidewalks and handicap ramps, and related reconstruction. This is an immediate prime/subcontract opportunity for concrete and site contractors.
source: City of Alpharetta solicitation / public bid record

title: Eagles Nest Church Campus — Future Retail / Dining / Daycare Phases
size: 16-acre campus; Phase 1 includes an 80,000 SF adaptive-reuse facility; future phases include Class A retail, dining, family-oriented uses and daycare
developer: Eagles Nest Church / ENA Group LLC; redevelopment partners include Regent Partners
timing: Phase 1 opened September 6, 2026. Public project updates state that future phases are planned for retail, dining, family-oriented businesses and a daycare partner, but no construction schedule has been published. Best current action is early relationship building with ownership/development partners and monitoring Roswell planning/permit activity.
source: AJC / Rough Draft / Eagles Nest project announcement

title: Gwinnett Technical College Building 2 — North Fulton Campus
size: ~45,500 SF instructional building; preliminary construction budget ~$24.4M
developer: Georgia State Financing & Investment Commission for Technical College System of Georgia / Gwinnett Technical College
timing: Design Professional RFQ closed September 3, 2026. The project is planned for CM/GC delivery, with design services anticipated to begin in October 2026 and a 12-14 month construction duration identified in procurement materials. Contractors should monitor for the CM/GC procurement and future subcontract packages.
source: Georgia procurement record / GSFIC solicitation summary

size: Wills Park baseball fields 1-8 lighting package
timing: Bid deadline passed September 3, 2026. Shift outreach from prime bidding to award tracking and subcontract/supplier follow-up with the selected contractor once the award is posted.

size: 10-year full-service maintenance program covering two municipal water storage tanks
timing: Proposals remain due September 10, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET. Scope includes inspections, rehabilitation, repairs, recoating, washout and preventive maintenance. Public contact: Julie Barnwell, jbarnwell@roswellgov.com, 770-664-6197.
source: Georgia Procurement Registry / City of Roswell solicitation

title: Western Corridor Sanitary Sewer Improvements
size: ~4,360 LF sewer + duplex pump station + electrical/control infrastructure
timing: Bids remain due September 17, 2026 at 10:00 AM local time. Scope includes ~2,860 LF gravity sewer, ~1,500 LF force main, trenchless crossings, pump station, controls, electrical building, emergency bypass pump and restoration. Mandatory pre-bid has passed, so suppliers/subcontractors should target eligible primes/plan holders. Public engineering contact reported: Jordan Johns, Garver, 678-264-8923, jnjohns@garverusa.com.
source: City of Cumming Utilities + public solicitation records
